newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil extends losses at close.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil extends losses at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Aug (3rd pos) 1,209 rgt/tonne June (south) 1,262.50
Open/Hi/Low 1,223/1,223/1,209 Prev close 1,275
Prev settlement 1,219 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES -Prices closed lower, extending overnight losses mainly due to plantation and technical selling, and lack of fresh developments. Trading was fairly moderate. August broke the support level of 1,220 and the next support will be 1,200. The near-term trend is still bearish.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - THe market saw selective interest, and selling was seen from plantation houses.
"Technically, the market looks weak. August futures fell below the 1,210 ringgit at the close and sentiment would continue to be bearish in the near-term," a technical analyst said.
"The market is likely to move downwards to the psychological level of 1,200 level and then to the next support of 1,180 level," he said.
"There were no other fundamentals. Technical selling emerged as the August futures continued to trade below the support level of 1,220 ringgit," a trader said.
Prices had earlier opened higher in line with a firmer close in Chicago soyoil futures overnight and shortcovering.
But traders said there was no follow-through support and prices dropped in the absence of fresh developments.
Lack of fresh tenders also prompted liquidation, they said.
Trading was fairly cautious and turnover was 1,821 lots.
The physicals market saw selling from plantation houses.
Physical June (south) saw offers at 1,262.50 against bids at 1,257.50 with earlier trades done at 1,265 and 1,260.
June (central) saw offers at 1,245 after bids at 1,242.50.
July (south) saw offers at 1,255 after bids of 1,247.50 and trade of 1,250.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered at $530, July at $525 and Aug/Sept at $517.50. July was traded at $525.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $567.50, July at $562.50, and Aug/Sept at $555. June was traded at $565 and July at $562.50 and $560.
June RBD palm stearin was offered at $392 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $275. -- Tan Lee Lee (275-6834) ($1-2.5160)
